articles.body_raw:
SADAF MODAK
& MOHAMED THAVER
AHMEDABAD, JUNE 17

THERE WERE seven Portuguese
nationals on the passenger list of
the Air India flight from
Ahmedabad to London, which
crashed on June 12. It turns out
ail seven had their roots in the is-
land of Diu, the former
Portuguese colony on the west-
ern coast of India.
According to local officials, a
total of 14 deaths from the
crash were of passengers with
links to Diu, including nine
from Bucharwada gram pan-
chayat. The sole survivor,

Viswashkumar Ramesh, is
among others with roots in Diu
whoare British nationals.
